I think the issue is more about flexibility in handling different use cases.  Those of us whose IT infrastructure employs Microsoft's Active Directory for user groups and permissioning is, I believe, just another use case, if you will.  Microsoft (in their infinite wisdom :-] ) does things like put spaces in their groups - for the default group is "domain users".

That said, RMR parses plain text into a data structure using white space as a delimiter (in this case of hadoop operations like -ls, there are probably others), instead of using another method, such as an api call to get explicitly defined data structure of, in this case, the parameters of a filesystem listing.  I posit that RMR could parse this structure more intelligently to handle this use case, perhaps through use of a regular expression.  I am not familiar enough with the source code to implement the change myself.
